Name: Measures must have descriptions (>= 15 chars)
Description: Every measure must have a human-readable description so Copilot, Q&A, and Data Agents can reason about it.

Name: Measures must have at least 1 synonym
Description: Q&A and Copilot use synonyms to match natural-language phrases.

Name: Measures must be in a Display Folder
Description: Display folders help end-users and Copilot navigate the model.

Name: Numeric measures must have a Format String
Description: Without a format string, AI-generated answers show raw decimals.
Expression: string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FormatString) and (DataType == DataType.Decimal or DataType == DataType.Int64 or DataType == DataType.Double)

Name: Measure names should not contain 'tmp', 'test', 'old', '_'
Description: Technical/debug names confuse end-users and AI assistants.
Expression: Name.ToLower().Contains("tmp") or Name.ToLower().Contains("test") or Name.ToLower().Contains("old") or Name.StartsWith("_")

Name: Visible columns must have descriptions
Description: Visible columns are user-facing and need descriptions for AI.

Name: Visible tables must have descriptions
Description: Tables represent business concepts; AI needs descriptions to disambiguate.

Name: Relationships should have descriptions
Description: Helps AI understand business semantics of joins.
